input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: We may assign to Affiliates and successors without consent, Vendor needs our consent (reasonableness qualified) and may never assign to a competitor, and Section 24.4 bars any Vendor termination, repricing or acceleration on our change of control — our preferred position.
